description: This PHP class 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroupDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for constructing the decorator with a 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' instance, retrieving it, and setting its associated 'DisplayFieldGroup' by ID, utilizing ORM reference mechanisms.
